question: Which of the following Iron and Steel Plants of India is situated on the coast of Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vishakhapatnam Steel Plant, also known as Vizag Steel, is located in Vishakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is the only shore-based steel plant in India.
 
• The plant was founded in 1971 and is known for its modern infrastructure and efficient production processes.
 
• Vishakhapatnam Steel Plant is strategically situated on the coast of the Bay of Bengal, making it advantageous for importing raw materials and exporting finished products.
 
• The plant plays a significant role in the industrial development of the region and contributes to the economy by providing employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhadravati Steel Plant**

 
 
• Located in Karnataka, it was established in 1923 and is one of the oldest steel plants in India.
 
• The plant is operated by Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel Limited.
 
 
 
• **Salem Steel Plant**
 
 
• Located in Tamil Nadu, it is a premier producer of stainless steel in India.
 
• The plant was commissioned in 1981 and is part of the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).
 
 
 
• **Durgapur Steel Plant**
 
 
• Situated in West Bengal, this plant was established in the late 1950s.
 
• It is one of the integrated steel plants under the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).
